content.text:
I found two bad values in `site/css/styles.css` and fixed both. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, with no differences.

- **Navbar (`.navbar`):** `position` had been changed to `absolute`. That took the navbar out of the page flow, so everything below it moved up 56px and the navbar shrank to fit its content. I set it back to `relative`. This was the main cause on both screen sizes.
- **Desktop heading (`.fs-3`, 1200px and wider):** the font size was `0.875rem`, which made the "Full Width Pics" title tiny and the page 16px shorter. I set it back to `1.75rem`.

I didn't approve or change any baselines, since the page now matches them as they are. I also didn't commit anything. The `.idea` and `.vscode` folders show up as untracked, but they were already there.
